label: 포자버섯
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE actual neutral source key drawing for a FOUR-combat-attribute combination in a small 2D game.
Input image 1: approved three-attribute comparison sheet, as the identity and coherent anatomical integration authority. Input image 2: approved single-attribute atlas, as material, palette and functional shape vocabulary. Both are supporting references, NOT output layouts.
Create exactly ONE complete character with ONLY the four selected attributes. Preserve the approved species and resolve all shared roots, intersections, proportions and silhouette together. One dominant continuous anatomical/material construction, sparse subordinate details, broad quiet surfaces. Do not pile four full accessories on a body, and do not import the fifth unselected attribute.
One neutral ready pose, mostly frontal with slight rightward orientation. Match the softly painted casual-game sprite style, thin crisp dark outlines, upper-left lighting, face, proportions and materials. Full subject centered on a square canvas with generous transparent padding; no edge touching or cropping.
Exactly TWO eyes, no mouth. Genuine transparent background. No labels, letters, diagrams, shadows, ground, loose particles, effects, extra poses, costumes, straps, held equipment, metal hardware, realistic anatomy or 3D toy rendering. Draw complete clean surfaces and naturally fitted connections. This is actual source artwork awaiting review, not an animation preview.

SPECIES: One squat ivory mushroom-stem creature with exactly two dark bead eyes, no mouth, two tiny ivory feet, and ONE broad coral-red cap. Continuous soft living fungal tissue and shared gills. Calm coral cap center. Cutting edges are thin sweeping lamellae; piercing one violet point; carapace warm terracotta/cream low protective shelves; guard teal cupped shelter shelves; secretion sparse embedded cyan/pink/gold vesicles.
SELECTED ATTRIBUTES ONLY: piercing + carapace + guard + secretion (관통 + 갑피 + 엄호 + 분비).
INTEGRATED CONSTRUCTION: ONE thick coral cap forms compact terracotta-and-cream protective shelves, broadening on the right into a cupped teal shelter side. Its upper seam narrows into ONE stiff violet point. Three small colorful spore vesicles are embedded in the same supporting seam. All remaining shelf edges stay thick, broad and softly rounded; no extended slicing lamellae.
